title: Earnings: fixed amount plus a percentage of profit

source.note: Text taken from the QP and MS PDFs (UCLES 2022).

stem:
Ahmed owns a company.
Each year he earns $56 000 plus 3% of the year’s profit.
Calculate the amount he earns in a year when the profit is $320 600.

title: Hourly rates: find the number of hours worked

source.note: Text taken from the QP and MS PDFs (UCLES 2021). The QP shows the three rates as a table; its cells are given here line by line in the QP's order.

stem:
Painter: $35 per hour
Plumber: Fixed charge $40 plus $26.50 per hour
Electrician: $48 per hour for the first 2 hours then $32 per hour
These are the rates charged by a painter, a plumber and an electrician who do some work for Mr Sharma.

parts.stem:
Mr Sharma pays the plumber $252.
Calculate how many hours the plumber works.

steps.name: pb
steps.note: MS: M1 for \(40+26.5x=252\) oe or B1 for 212 seen.

parts.stem:
Mr Sharma pays the electrician $224.
Calculate how many hours the electrician works.

steps.name: pc
steps.note: MS: M1 for \((224-2\times48)\div32\) oe or \(2\times48+32(x-2)=224\) soi.

title: Earnings: percentage spent

source.note: Text taken from the QP and MS PDFs (UCLES 2023).

stem:
In 2021, Anil earns $37 000.
He spends $12 400 on bills in 2021.
Calculate the percentage of his earnings he spends on bills.

steps.name: m
steps.note: MS: M1 for \(\frac{12\,400}{37\,000}\,[\times100]\) oe. If 0 scored, SC1 for answer 66.5 or 66.48 to 66.49.

title: Hourly rates: find the number of hours worked
source: Similar to 0580/42/F/M/21 Q1(b)(c); same mark structure
constraints: b<a  # lower rate after the first 2 hours
stem:
A gardener charges a fixed charge of ${F|money} plus ${h|money} per hour. A tiler charges ${a|money} per hour for the first 2 hours then ${b|money} per hour.
(b) Mrs Lim pays the gardener ${X|money}. Calculate how many hours the gardener works.
(c) Mrs Lim pays the tiler ${Y|money}. Calculate how many hours the tiler works.

steps.name: pb
steps.note: (b) Fixed charge + rate × hours = amount paid oe, or B1 for (amount paid − fixed charge) seen.

steps.name: pc
steps.note: (c) (amount − 2 × first rate) ÷ second rate oe, or \(2\times{a|int}+{b|int}(x-2)={Y|num}\) soi.

contexts.note: base stem, params and step texts above
